title: Design System: Arnav Bule GitHub Profile

display-desktop.purpose: Uppercase Space Grotesk glyph paths; natural tracking; width capped at 635 SVG units.

display-mobile.purpose: Recomposed mobile hero; width capped at 565 SVG units.

prose-desktop.purpose: Hero supporting prose; separate from GitHub-controlled README text.

terminal-desktop.purpose: Live SVG text using system monospace fallbacks.

motion.name: signal-pulse
motion.purpose: Stroke dash offset travels from 100 to 0; opacity 0 at start, .9 at 8% and 72%, 0 at 86% and 100%.

motion.name: signal-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to the pulse under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; the static signal remains.

motion.name: project-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: QR seasons GIF switches to the static project capture through a picture source.

narrative.overview: Extracted from the accepted developer-terminal direction and implemented artwork. Graphite and warm paper support strong outlined lettering, a compact console, and original branching circuit geometry. Descriptive wording is provisional; root DESIGN.md owns implemented tokens. The custom SVG system, GitHub-controlled README, and local preview shell are distinct surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet green signal paths with one warm identity response
Outlined Space Grotesk paired with readable terminal text
Real project imagery and direct textual links
Theme variants and a recomposed mobile introduction

rules.name: The Host Boundary Rule
rules.body: Custom artwork tokens do not override GitHub typography or page chrome. Local preview styling only approximates the host.

dos: Do generate all theme and viewport variants from shared sources.
Do preserve static reduced-motion reading and meaningful image alternatives.
Do maintain provenance for inspectable project captures.
Do derive graph nodes and accessible counts from the same data.
donts: Don't infer exact live GitHub sanitization or spacing from the preview.
Don't put arbitrary JavaScript in the README.
Don't convert repository distribution into proficiency claims.
